instruction: Enable tap-to-click functionality for the touchpad.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling tap-to-click by setting tap-to-click to true. The evaluator verifies the gsettings value is 'true'. Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts tap-to-click setting state using 'gsettings get' command
Metric (exact_match) correctly performs string comparison between result and expected value
Expected value 'true\n' correctly matches the actual output format of gsettings command (includes newline)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the only requirement in the instruction (enable tap-to-click)
Proper data flow: setup disables tap-to-click, getter reads current state, metric compares with expected enabled state
Edge cases handled: command failures return None which correctly fails the exact match comparison
